manifest.method: For each named tokenizer, delta = len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) per fixed pair; per-model value is the mean over eight pairs. Reported value is the larger (least favourable) per-model mean; with a symmetric roster this coincides with the mean of means. value_lo/value_hi = min/max per-pair delta on the floor tokenizer. English arms follow the ratified english_mapping's own phrasing. Local deterministic count: tiktoken 0.13.0 (cl100k_base, o200k_base).
